map.视角计算器 使用指南: Angle of View Calculator User Guide
map.视角计算器依据传感器尺寸（全画幅 36×24mm）与焦距求镜头水平与垂直视角，适: The angle of view calculator derives the horizontal and vertical angles of view from sensor size (full frame 36x24mm) and focal length, suited to composition, focal range selection and field-of-view estimation.
map.视角 = 2 · arctan(传感器边长 / (2 · 焦距)): Angle of view = 2 * arctan(sensor side / (2 * focal length))
map.由焦距与传感器三尺寸求三视角。: Derive the three angles of view from focal length and the three sensor dimensions.
map.：全幅 36×24、对角 43.3mm、50mm：水平 ≈ 39.6°、垂直 ≈: Full frame 36x24 with a 43.3mm diagonal at 50mm: horizontal = about 39.6 degrees, vertical = about 27 degrees, diagonal = about 46.8 degrees; when stitching, work from the horizontal angle to compute overlap.
map.：APS-C 24×16 同 50mm：水平 ≈ 27° 比全幅窄，取景如 75: APS-C 24x16 at the same 50mm: horizontal = about 27 degrees, narrower than full frame, framing like a 75mm equivalent, so you need to step back to fit it in.
map.对角视角有什么用？: What is the diagonal angle of view useful for?
map.判断画面最大张角能否容下主体对角线，接片与广角边缘畸变评估参考。: Check whether the widest angle in the frame can contain the subject's diagonal; useful as a reference for stitching and wide-angle edge distortion assessment.
map.三视角能互推吗？: Can the three angles of view be derived from each other?
map.不能简单互推，需各自传感器尺寸代入 FOV=2atan(尺寸/2f)。: They cannot be simply converted; plug each sensor's own size into FOV = 2atan(size / 2f).
